title: How can I get my product key?

posts.author: AluadoBR
posts.body:
Hello, everyone! Around 6 years ago, I purchased RPG Maker XP and installed it on my laptop. However, I need to buy a new one (my old laptop is literally dying lol), and I can't find my product key, so I can install it on the new laptop.
I couldn't find it on the software itself, I couldn't find the email exchange where I purchased and got the key, and when looking for answers on Google, all I found were people asking this question here in the forum and, eventually, someone from tech support helping.
So... can I get any help, please?

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body:
The contact prompt for support is
here.
I imagine as long as you provide the email address you associated with the purchase that they’ll be able to look it up.
